description: This file defines an abstract class 'source' which serves as a parent class for various data source connectors within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for loading and saving configuration, mapping fields, loading vardefs, and administrative properties. The class also handles encryption/decryption of sensitive properties and provides hooks for testing connectivity and filtering modules.

classes.name: source
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a data source connector in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It provides loading, saving, and configuration management functionalities, as well as administrative property flags and hooks for subclasses to implement specific data retrieval logic.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads the field mapping configuration from a file based on the class name.

methods.name: saveMappingHook
methods.description: Hook method called when mapping is saved, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: loadVardefs
methods.description: Loads vardef definitions for the source, which describe field metadata.

methods.name: getFieldsWithParams
methods.description: Returns fields that match a specific parameter and value in the vardefs.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Serializes and saves the source's configuration to a PHP file, handling encryption if configured.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted configuration properties if not already decrypted.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from PHP files into the class property.

methods.name: filterAllowedModules
methods.description: Filters the module list to determine which modules are allowed for connection. Default implementation allows all.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the current field mapping.

methods.name: getOriginalMapping
methods.description: Loads the original mapping from the default or custom file.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Sets the internal mapping array.

methods.name: getFieldDefs
methods.description: Returns the field definitions loaded from vardefs.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the source's configuration, decrypting if necessary.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the source configuration and marks it as decrypted.

methods.name: setEAPM
methods.description: Associates an ExternalAPIBase instance with this source.

methods.name: getEAPM
methods.description: Retrieves the associated ExternalAPIBase instance.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the 'properties' part of the configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the 'properties' part of the configuration.

methods.name: propertyExists
methods.description: Checks if a certain property exists and is non-empty in the configuration.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value from the configuration, decrypting if needed.

methods.name: hasTestingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the source supports testing connectivity.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs a connectivity test; should be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: isEnabledInWizard
methods.description: Checks if the connector should be available in the data import wizard.

methods.name: isEnabledInHover
methods.description: Checks if hover link features are enabled for this connector.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminProperties
methods.description: Checks if the connector appears in the admin property configuration.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminMapping
methods.description: Checks if the connector appears in the admin mapping configuration.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the connector appears in the admin display configuration.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminSearch
methods.description: Checks if the connector appears in the admin search view.

methods.name: getRequiredConfigFields
methods.description: Returns the list of required configuration fields.

methods.name: isRequiredConfigFieldsSet
methods.description: Checks if all required configuration fields are set.

methods.name: getRequiredConfigFieldsForButton
methods.description: Returns configuration fields required for the 'Get Data' button to be active.

methods.name: isRequiredConfigFieldsForButtonSet
methods.description: Checks if all config fields necessary for the 'Get Data' button are set.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Helper method for logging information about the source.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a single item from the data source; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a list of items from the data source; must be implemented by subclasses.
